description: The figure presents two line plots illustrating training rewards over steps for different training sets and methods. The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," shows training rewards on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, plotted against steps on the x-axis, which spans from 0 to 500. Two methods are compared: Llama-LUFFY-Easy, represented by a red line with a shaded confidence interval, and Llama-On-Policy-Easy, shown as a blue line. Both methods start at a training reward of approximately 0.0 and increase over steps, with the red line consistently achieving higher rewards than the blue line, reaching a final reward of about 0.4. The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," displays training rewards on the y-axis from 0.0 to 0.2, with the same x-axis range. It compares Llama-On-Policy-Hard (blue line) and Llama-LUFFY-Hard (red line). The blue line remains near 0.0 for most of the steps, showing minimal improvement, while the red line starts at 0.0, increases steadily, and reaches a final reward of approximately 0.2.
